verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-item file actions through the Files API (create, read, edit, move, delete), folder listing, and a title about performant uploads. Nothing documents batch or bulk endpoints, or a UI for acting on many items at once. Looping over single-item API calls is a developer building block, not the bulk-operation capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
